Enum Class GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape>
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.gametest.GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape>, Constable
Enclosing class:
GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex
public static enum GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape extends Enum<GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape>
How the indexed instances are spread over item types. An ItemStack hash that ignores data components puts every stack of the same item in one bucket, so the shape decides how long the collision chains are. SPREAD is the mildest case and SINGLE_ITEM the worst.

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    FEW_ITEMS
    Spread over a few item types only, distinct by data components within each.
    HEAVY_COMPONENTS
    Spread as SPREAD, but each stack carries a large component payload, so that the cost of hashing the components themselves is visible.
    MIXED
    GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.MIXED_COMPONENT_FRACTION of the instances carry a component, the rest are plain.
    PLAIN
    Every instance is a plain stack carrying no data components at all, made distinct by its item and its count.
    SINGLE_ITEM
    Every instance on one item, distinct only by data components.
    SPREAD
    Spread over every registered item, with component variants to reach the target size.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • SPREAD

      public static final GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape SPREAD
      Spread over every registered item, with component variants to reach the target size.

    • SINGLE_ITEM

      public static final GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape SINGLE_ITEM
      Every instance on one item, distinct only by data components. This is what a storage full of enchanted books or damaged tools looks like.

    • FEW_ITEMS

      public static final GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape FEW_ITEMS
      Spread over a few item types only, distinct by data components within each.

    • HEAVY_COMPONENTS

      public static final GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape HEAVY_COMPONENTS
      Spread as SPREAD, but each stack carries a large component payload, so that the cost of hashing the components themselves is visible.

    • PLAIN

      public static final GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape PLAIN
      Every instance is a plain stack carrying no data components at all, made distinct by its item and its count. This is what a large modpack's storage mostly looks like: many unique items, few component variants.

    • MIXED

      public static final GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.Shape MIXED
      GameTestsPerformanceIngredientIndex.MIXED_COMPONENT_FRACTION of the instances carry a component, the rest are plain. A more realistic modpack storage than either PLAIN or SPREAD: bulk material dominates, with a tail of enchanted, damaged or named items.
